responsibility: Defines the ISO process-synchronization semaphore interface. It introduces the opaque SEMAPHORE type and operations to create and destroy semaphores, claim and release them, and attempt a nonblocking conditional claim, forming the public mutual-exclusion API used by concurrent gm2 programs on top of the Processes subsystem.
same_name_distinction: This .def file is the public interface half of the Semaphores pair: it declares the opaque SEMAPHORE type and synchronization operations, while Semaphores.mod defines the underlying records, wait queues, and scheduler interactions.
